title: Portal home loads with Trader dashboard
description: Open http://127.0.0.1:5173/ . IMPORTANT: this portal has NO login page and NO authentication - do not look for a login form or credentials; a persona is pre-selected automatically. Verify the application shell renders: header brand 'National e-Metrology', a navigation bar with tabs such as Trader/Officer/Public Verification, and the Trader dashboard content area visible showing instrument/application sections.

steps.description: Open the portal URL directly in the browser - there is NO login page and NO authentication in this app; do not search for login forms or credentials
Verify the app shell renders: header brand, navigation bar with tabs such as Trader / Officer / Public Verification
Trader dashboard content area is visible showing instrument/application sections
No error overlay or blank screen

title: Register a new instrument from the Trader dashboard
description: Open http://127.0.0.1:5173/ (no login needed). On the Trader dashboard find the instrument registration form (fields like model, serial number). Choose any approved model from the available options, enter a unique serial number like SN-UI-<random digits>, fill any other required fields, and submit. Verify a success indication appears and/or the new instrument appears in the instrument list on the page.

steps.description: Open the portal URL directly in the browser - there is NO login page and NO authentication in this app; do not search for login forms or credentials
On the Trader dashboard locate the instrument registration form with model and serial number fields
Select any approved model from available options and enter a unique serial number like SN-UI-4821
Fill other required fields and submit the registration form
A success indication appears and/or the new instrument appears in the instrument list

title: Public verification page shows certificate status for a valid token
description: Open http://127.0.0.1:5173/#/verify/TOKEN_VALID_2026 (no login needed; this hash route opens the Public Verification view directly). Alternatively open http://127.0.0.1:5173/ and click the 'Public Verification' tab then ensure token field contains TOKEN_VALID_2026 and trigger verify. Verify the public certificate status view renders certificate details/status information without requiring authentication.

steps.description: Open http://127.0.0.1:5173/#/verify/TOKEN_VALID_2026 - no login needed; this hash route opens the Public Verification view
Public certificate status view renders certificate details or status information
No authentication was required to see it

title: Public verification shows not-found feedback for an unknown token
description: Open http://127.0.0.1:5173/ , go to the Public Verification tab, replace the token with an obviously invalid value such as INVALID-TOKEN-XYZ-123 and trigger verification. Verify the UI shows an error / not-found / invalid result state rather than certificate details.

steps.description: Open the portal URL directly in the browser - there is NO login page and NO authentication in this app; do not search for login forms or credentials
Go to the Public Verification tab and replace the token with INVALID-TOKEN-XYZ-123, then trigger verification
UI shows an error / not-found / invalid result state instead of certificate details

title: Officer workspace renders verification sessions

Verify the Officer workspace renders with statutory workflow sections/lists such as applications for scrutiny, verification sessions, or testing tools, and no crash/error overlay appears.

steps.description: Open http://127.0.0.1:5173/#officer - deep link switches to officer workspace as Legal Metrology Officer; no login needed

title: Create and submit an application via the Trader dashboard
description: Open http://127.0.0.1:5173/ (no login). On the Trader dashboard locate the applications section, start creating a new verification application for one of the listed/registered instruments, complete any declaration checkbox if present, and submit it. Verify the application appears in the list with a submitted/pending state indication.

steps.description: Open the portal URL directly in the browser - there is NO login page and NO authentication in this app; do not search for login forms or credentials
On the Trader dashboard open the applications section and start creating a new verification application for a listed instrument
Complete any declaration checkbox if present and submit the application
The application appears in the list with a submitted/pending state indication

title: Role persona switcher changes active persona
description: Open http://127.0.0.1:5173/ (no login). Use the persona/role selector in the navigation bar (labels include 'Trader / Instrument Owner' and 'Legal Metrology Officer (LMO)'). Switch to 'Legal Metrology Officer (LMO)' and verify the app reflects the LMO persona (e.g. officer workspace becomes active or persona label updates). Then switch back to the trader persona and verify it changes again.

steps.description: Open the portal URL directly in the browser - there is NO login page and NO authentication in this app; do not search for login forms or credentials
Use the persona/role selector in the navbar (labels include 'Trader / Instrument Owner' and 'Legal Metrology Officer (LMO)') and switch to LMO
App reflects the LMO persona (officer workspace active or persona label updates)
Switch back to the trader persona
Persona changes back accordingly
